articles.title: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower
articles.mainIdea: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower
articles.summary: Business Wire: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower. NEW YORK, April 02, 2026--Court Square Capital Partners ("Court Square"), a leading U.S. middle market private equity firm, today announced it has acquired a majority stake in CallTower (the "Company"), a global leader in enterprise-class cloud communications and collaboration solutions. Court Square is acquiring the company from BV Investment Partners, which acquired a majority stake in 2023. Related tickers mentioned: CSCO.
